label: AI-GENERATED BEHAVIOURAL SIMULATION CAMPAIGN - V2 - HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED
driver: results/run_campaign.py (reads this manifest; uses automation.simulation.buck_stage and ngspice_runner unmodified)
parameter_sources: design/design_decisions.json (schema 3, 2026-10-10) with design/research/{mosfet,capacitors,inductor,gate_driver}.json after their verify_*.json corrections; task-provided values are labelled in simulation_report.md

cascade_controller.structure: outer voltage PI (V -> A) -> i_ref clamp -> inner average-current PI (A -> duty) with Vref/Vin feedforward -> duty clamp [0, 0.85] -> module comparator PWM; inductor current = i(Vld) + i(Vcout) filtered by a first-order 10 kHz low-pass (stand-in for the ePWM CTR=ZERO average sampling); output voltage through the module 20 kHz feedback filter
cascade_controller.design_basis: kpi = 2 pi 4 kHz L / Vin(400 V) for an inner crossover of about 4 kHz (fs/12.5); kpv tuned by bisection on the small-signal loop gain (plant 1/(sC) || R, closed inner loop, 20 kHz filter, T/2 PWM delay) for an outer crossover of 2.3 kHz (middle of the 2.0-2.5 kHz band of design_decisions.json assumptions_accepted.voltage_loop_crossover_Hz); analytical margins are recomputed by the driver and stored in results/loop_gain_analysis.json
cascade_controller.firmware_status: NO FIRMWARE EXISTS (assumptions register A-34: hardware/firmware contract only). These gains are a behavioural stand-in for the TMS320F28335 implementation and must not be copied into firmware without a discrete-time redesign (sampling, one-sample delay, ADC scaling, anti-windup, current-reference clamp coordinated with the 37.5 A OC trip).
cascade_controller.iref_max_basis: 35 A: below the TMCS1133 OC trip (37.5 A, design_decisions sensing.current.oc_threshold_A) and the vendor-style I_sat 37.3 A; added assumption
cascade_controller.iref_min_basis: -10 A: synchronous operation continues at no load (baseline magnetics no_load_ccm_reverse_current_A -2.8 to -3.4 A); added assumption

module_pi_reference.note: module defaults; single voltage loop; crossover about 97 Hz (analytical); used only by cl_400V_singleloop_modulePI

parasitic_sweep.basis: L_loop 25 nH typical / 35 nH worst board loop plus up to 50 nH with standing TO-247 leads (design_decisions power_stage.mosfet.selection_basis, KR-PCB-004 adapted); C_oss 130 pF per device at 400 V (gate_driver.json turn-off dv/dt envelope; datasheet 103 pF at 1000 V, Co(tr) 238 pF, fetched-datasheet); design di/dt 2.5 A/ns (gate_driver.json / verify of capacitors.json); R_loop 0.5 ohm is the module default (lightly damped, Q about 28 at 25 nH) with a 2 ohm sensitivity case

limits.source: design_decisions.json assumptions_accepted, capacitors, magnetics, sensing, protection

analytical_reference.source: design_decisions.json operating_points / magnetics / capacitors; research records mosfet.json, capacitors.json, inductor.json (verified); calculations.json was not available when the campaign ran

formulas.i_cin_rms: sqrt(D (Io^2 + dI^2/12) - (D Io)^2) (capacitors.json KR-CAP-002): 12.50-12.64 A at 25 A, 13.74-13.87 A at 27.5 A
formulas.i_cout_rms: dI/sqrt(12): 2.16 A at 400 V (7.49 A ripple), 2.86 A worst (9.92 A)
formulas.conduction_per_device_W: I_rms^2 R_DS(on): 15.3 W per device at 400 V / 25 A / 48.5 mohm (mosfet.json)
formulas.dead_time_W: 2 t_d f_s V_SD I_o: 2.9 W at 25 A / 4.6 V / 250 ns (mosfet.json, KR-GD-009)
formulas.dcr_W: I_rms^2 R_dc(100 C): 10.0 W at 25 A, 12.1 W at 27.5 A (inductor.json)
formulas.vout_ripple_Vpp: dI/(8 fs C) + ESR dI: 0.25 Vpp (capacitors.json, 108 uF)
formulas.vin_ripple_Vpp: dQ/C_min + ESR I_pp: 3.5 Vpp at 25 A, 3.9 Vpp at 27.5 A (capacitors.json corrected)
formulas.step_excursion_V: dI_step/(2 pi fc C_min) + ESR dI_step: 7.4 V at 2.5 kHz, 9.2 V at 2.0 kHz, 8.1 V at 2.3 kHz (capacitors.json)
formulas.load_dump_V: 25 A/(2 pi fc C_min) + ESR 25 A: 14.8 V at 2.5 kHz, 18.5 V at 2.0 kHz, 16.1 V at 2.3 kHz -> 215-218 V vs 230 V OVP (CR-04)
